ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels account for approximately 85% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels providing high contrast in the form of discrete spots and linear streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dispersed high-intensity white micro-pixels (mottling) across the entire dark field; concentrated cluster of high-intensity linear white bands located on the inner left lobe adjacent to the median notch; yellowish-tan textured pixel clusters at the distal lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 48 degrees and a narrow vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Generally smooth convex edges near the notch, transitioning to irregular, high-relief serrations at the distal tips where organic growth distorts the linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature (outward sweep) observed on the trailing edges of both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous small, circular white pixel clusters (rosettes) scattered randomly across the ventral surface; large, complex three-dimensional clusters of light-colored barnacles at the outer tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 3-4 distinct, parallel diagonal white linear markings (rake marks) on the inner left lobe; isolated vertical linear disruption on the inner right lobe near the notch base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant linear white rake marks on the inner left lobe; extensive barnacle encrustation causing physical deformation of the fluke tip silhouettes.
other_distinctive_markers: Yellow-tan hue of barnacle colonies at the fluke tips, which varies from the primary black/white pixel palette of the fluke surface.
